title: Why your vision goes black when you stand up 😵
subject: eyes
description:
How often does this happen to you? 👇

Why does your vision go dark or fuzzy when you stand up too fast? Gravity pulls blood into your legs, your blood pressure dips, and your body races to fix it in seconds. An occasional head rush is usually harmless; frequent episodes are worth asking a doctor about.

Sources: Mayo Clinic ("Orthostatic hypotension is more than feeling dizzy"), MedlinePlus / NIH National Library of Medicine ("Orthostatic hypotension"), American Family Physician (Lanier et al., 2011)
